name: peerpanda
description: Ask questions and get custom reports on your competitors

interface.longDescription: Ask questions and get custom reports on the competitors you track in PeerPanda. Search your account's competitor list, activity timeline, and uploaded documents, then cite findings with their PeerPanda links. Access is limited to data available to the connected PeerPanda account.
defaultPrompt: What have our competitors been up to lately?
Generate a battlecard on our T1 competitors.
What industry events should we know about?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: What have our competitors been up to lately?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_competitors, then get_competitor_activities with since about 60 days ago. Answer from the activity summaries and cite each claim with its relevance icon, title, PeerPanda URL, and date.

positive.prompt: What are the biggest stories this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_competitor_activities with sort relevance and since at the start of the current week. Lead with the highest relevance icons.
Call search_competitor_data for pricing, including local-language synonyms when the account corpus is not English. Cite each activity or document hit with its PeerPanda URL.

positive.prompt: What documents do we have on our top competitor?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a competitor slug with get_competitors, then call get_competitor_documents for that slug. Cite each file by name and PeerPanda URL.

positive.prompt: Generate a battlecard on our T1 competitors.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_competitors and get_account_info to identify the priority competitors and tags, then gather their recent activities. Produce a battlecard from those results and cite each claim.

negative.description: Own-product writing is not competitor research
negative.prompt: Draft a launch email for our own product. Do not look up competitors.

negative.description: A pricing calculation is not a database search
negative.prompt: If our list price is 1200, what is 15 percent off?

negative.description: Scheduling is not a PeerPanda task
negative.prompt: Put a meeting with the sales team on Friday at 10.
